description: Ministry of Sport and Youth Affairs - Suspend the Registration of the Sri Lanka Karate - Do Federation, - Appointed Temporary Committee for Operational
reasoning: This gazette notification contains regulations made under the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, specifically suspending the registration of a national sports federation and making interim arrangements. It represents a legal/regulatory action by the Minister exercising powers vested by existing legislation, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
